title: Who would you like to chat with?
intro: No lessons here: share everyday moments, continue remembered topics and chat without unsolicited corrections.
gameEntryDescription: Board games and 1A2B work without voice; guessing games and Mystery need a Gemini key.
clearRecentConfirm: Clear recent chat dates? Your saved shared topics will remain.
recentEmpty: People you've spoken with will appear here for easy follow-up.
noMatches: No matching friends. Try a different name or interest.
privacy: Only actual chat dates are recorded. Topic memory is on by default and can be disabled or cleared in Settings. Friends are fictional AI characters, not real users who are online.
disabled: Conversation memory is off. Turn it on in Settings → Memory.
disabledHint: Conversation memory is off. Enable it in Settings → Memory.
autoUpdateConfirm: Allow AI to update this topic after future chats? Manually edited details may be overwritten.
noTopics: No shared topics yet. A single meaningful conversation can create memories; you can also add one manually.
clearTopicsConfirm: Delete all shared topics with this friend?

capture.empty: No specific topic was found to remember from the latest conversation.
capture.error: This memory capture failed. Previously saved memories are safe.
capture.error-key: The Gemini Key cannot access memory extraction. Check text-model permissions in Settings (separate from live voice).
capture.error-quota: The Gemini text-model rate or usage limit was reached. Try later or review quota in AI Studio.
capture.error-network: The memory request could not connect. Previously saved memories are safe.
capture.error-service: Gemini memory extraction is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
capture.error-response: Gemini returned an unreadable memory response. No new memory was added this time.

rolePromise: A friend, not a teacher · no grading or surprise corrections.
liveRolePromise: A natural conversation, not a lesson. Your friend won't correct you unless asked.
chatModeChanged: Changed · applies from the next reply.
chatModeSavedNext: Saved · applies from the next conversation.
chatModeHintNatural: Chat mainly in your own language; your friend follows when you consistently switch to the target language.
chatModeHintBilingual: Recommended: chat mainly in the language you're learning. Ask in your own language if you're stuck. One language per reply; your friend adapts naturally.
chatModeHintImmersion: Always chat in the language you're learning. Your friend adjusts clarity but won't switch to your native language.

textStarters.targetHint: You can start in English with {{name}}, or tap a simple {{language}} phrase below. {{name}} will keep it easy.

meaning.intro: Hi {{name}}! I want to introduce myself.

textStarters.heading: Tap a phrase to start chatting
textStarters.cafe: Hi {{name}}! Can we pretend we are at a café? I would like a coffee, please.
textStarters.intro: Hi {{name}}! I would like to introduce myself. Where should I start?
textStarters.smalltalk: Hey {{name}}! How has your day been?

topics.photo-story: Hi {{name}}! Can we talk about a photo that tells a story?
topics.photo-moment: Hey {{name}}! I want to share a small moment from today. What photo would you take?
topics.question-smalljoy: Hi {{name}}! What little thing made you smile today?
topics.question-weekend: Hey {{name}}! If we could plan a perfect weekend, what would we do?
topics.role-cafe: Hi {{name}}! Let’s pretend we are in a café. You order first!
topics.role-travel: Hey {{name}}! Let’s pretend we are lost in a new city. How do we find our way?
topics.mood-heavy: Hi {{name}}. I had a difficult day. Can we talk for a bit?
topics.mood-grateful: Hey {{name}}! What is one thing you are grateful for today?
topics.play-rematch: Hi {{name}}! Imagine we just finished a game. Would you play again?
topics.play-wildcard: Hey {{name}}! Have you ever seen a surprising comeback in a game?
topics.fortune-lucky: Hi {{name}}! For fun, what lucky sign would you give me today?
topics.fortune-change: Hey {{name}}! If my next chapter could be different, what should I try?

dailyQuoteStarter: Today’s thought: “{{quote}}” I’d love to talk about it.
dailyFortuneContinue: I'd like to follow up on the fortune reading you just gave me. What does its main point mean for today?

dailyFortuneStarters.goodFor: What would be good for me to do today?
dailyFortuneStarters.watchOut: What should I watch out for today?
